@note: The library’s one list of categories (Morg, Oct 31, 2026: categories are reference tags, curated in one list, and a card picks one from it, never a hand-keyed name). A category is what a card’s tile says: its tag, a string in build/text/en.json that Morg approves. A deck is where cards are stored: one file in build/decks/, its official source, and the draw’s rules for it (league and flags). Every deck shows its category on its tiles, and a card may name another category with its own tag (a category id from this list). build/build.py reads this file: the decks below, in this order, are the daily’s pool (DAILY) and the template’s TAG, and it refuses a deck or a card tag that isn’t on the list. A new category needs Morg’s name and its tag string in en.json, and goes on the list before any card uses it. A new deck goes at the end of decks. league: the draw allows at most LEAGUE_MAX cards a day from one league (empty for none, * for one per card, from its source site). flags: women (every card counts as a women’s game card), rules (every card counts as a rules card), slang (at most one slang card a day across these decks, and never a red one). home: the deck a new card in a category without decks of its own goes to (the Card Room lets Morg pick another).
